claim: The shell body of the deploy-functions shell-script page gains and loses the same thirty-five lines across landings that never name it. The lines are the whole of the shell function wait_for_postgres. A landing writes it in, the next landing takes it out, and each landing belongs to whatever work its message names, so neither writer is doing anything about this file. Over the two hundred newest commits touching infrastructure/cluster/operation/deploy-functions/deploy-functions.shell-script.shell.sh, fifty-seven are a pure thirty-five lines added or a pure thirty-five lines taken away, alternating. So the body of a script the cluster sources depends on which landing ran last rather than on what anyone wrote, and half the time a deploy reads a script without wait_for_postgres in it.

evidence:
Read on 2026-09-21 against this checkout.

What flaps. Between commits ce96fc413bb and 05179ac8598 the file differs by exactly the definition of wait_for_postgres, which takes a namespace, a service and a timeout, polls kubectl for a pod labelled app=postgres, and dies where no pod answers inside the timeout. ce96fc413bb takes those thirty-five lines away; 05179ac8598 puts the same thirty-five back.

That neither landing is about this file. ce96fc413bb is `ablate the fun section into the topics`, and the rest of its diff is the removal of a book section under alan/book/pages/all-about-alan/sections/notes and the index rows beside it. 05179ac8598 is `message to thea is read, and read is the file's absence`. Nothing in either names a shell script. The same pairing runs back through 3a33d61d04d, da37c350957, 3cef11e5519, ffb54fbeb7f, 4f3160090d3 and 1fca21ccbfb, alternating take-away and put-back.

How the count was taken. Over the two hundred newest commits touching that path, the numstat rows that are exactly thirty-five added and none taken away, or none added and thirty-five taken away, number fifty-seven.

Which writer takes the lines away. The apply that landed this finding said so itself, unasked: `deploy-functions.shell-script.shell.sh was written again by the group deploy-functions keeps`, and the same line for mirror-base-images. That landing named only a finding page under domain/finding/pages, and its diff over the shell body is thirty-five lines taken away and none added. So the group writes the short body, and it writes it on a landing that never names the file.

Which writer puts them back is unmeasured. It is not the group, which had just written the body without them.

That nothing wants the lines. deploy-functions.shell-script.ts states `shell: "sh"` and `scripting: {}`, so the body is a file property beside the page. Its code file names no wait_for_postgres, and neither does any other file in this repository: a search for the symbol answers only the shell body itself. Nothing sources it and nothing calls it, so the short body the group writes is the right one and the put-back is what is wrong.

What is unmeasured. Which program restores the thirty-five lines. Whether it moves other file properties the same way; mirror-base-images.shell-script.shell.sh moves by one line on the same landings, which says it is not only this file.
